item.case_name: Fact piece about a real thing
item.title: Meet the Real F-35A

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen mini-documentary introducing the real F-35A Lightning II. Show it taking off from a runway, then flying. Label it 'F-35A Lightning II', with 'One engine' and 'Conventional takeoff' appearing in turn. Calm English narration explaining those two facts. Real aircraft proportions, not a sci-fi jet.

item.tests: Tests whether a short factual aircraft film preserves the named variant's visible geometry and operating characteristics.

answer_sheet.Aircraft and variant: The real F-35A Lightning II, not the F-35B or F-35C.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: F-35A Lightning II; One engine; Conventional takeoff.
answer_sheet.Narration: Calm English narration explaining that the F-35A has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway; exact wording and voice are your call.
answer_sheet.Visual style and setting: Realistic documentary imagery; runway location, weather and camera angles are your call.
answer_sheet.Music: Your call, provided the narration remains clear.

must_haves: The aircraft has the recognizable F-35 configuration: one rear engine exhaust, two outward-canted vertical tails and no canards.
The takeoff shows a forward runway roll and lift-off, not hovering or a vertical launch.
The same aircraft design remains consistent between the runway and airborne views.
All three requested labels appear exactly and are legible.
Audible English narration correctly describes one engine and conventional runway takeoff without attributing F-35B hover capability to the F-35A.

turns.text: Please make a little mini-documentary introducing the real F-35A Lightning II, because I want it to feel like a straightforward introduction to the actual aircraft. I sometimes worry that aircraft videos end up looking more like imaginary movie jets than the real thing. What I have in mind is showing it taking off from a runway and then flying, and the whole thing should be 8 seconds long and widescreen. Put the label 'F-35A Lightning II' on it, with 'One engine' and 'Conventional takeoff' appearing in turn. Please use calm English narration explaining those two facts, meaning that it has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway. Keep the aircraft proportions real rather than making it look like a sci-fi jet.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second factual mini-documentary introducing the real-world Lockheed Martin F-35A Lightning II. Natural aviation documentary photography, realistic daylight, neutral color, no cinematic fantasy. Accurate aircraft geometry throughout: a single-seat gray stealth fighter with compact blended fuselage, short trapezoidal swept wings, two outward-canted vertical tails, two angular side air intakes, ONE rear engine exhaust nozzle, conventional tricycle landing gear. Preserve believable real F-35A proportions and markings; no extra engines, invented wings, sci-fi modifications, hover, vertical takeoff, lift fan, or weapons firing. 0–4 seconds: side-front three-quarter telephoto tracking view of an F-35A already at takeoff speed on a real runway; conventional rolling takeoff, nose rotates up and wheels leave runway smoothly. 4–8 seconds: clean cut to the SAME aircraft in a realistic shallow climb, then flying against a pale blue sky, landing gear retracting naturally. Keep entire aircraft visible, restrained stable camera. Readable clean white sans-serif screen text: persistent upper-left title exactly 'F-35A Lightning II'. Lower-left fact caption exactly 'One engine' from 0 to 4 seconds; replace it with exactly 'Conventional takeoff' from 4 to 8 seconds. No other prominent text. Calm clear adult English documentary voice, natural measured pace, speaking exactly: 'The F-thirty-five A has one engine. It takes off conventionally from a runway.' Narration begins immediately and finishes within eight seconds. Quiet realistic jet and runway ambience under the voice, no music, no dramatic sound effects. Educational and straightforward, not an action movie.
